Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Data Literacy Communications Internship at TotalEnergies Belgium. As a junior digital marketer with a strong technical foundation in web design, SEO, and content creation, I am excited about the opportunity to support your data literacy initiatives and contribute to your mission of carbon neutrality.

In my current role at Episto, I create engaging content and manage WordPress sites, which has honed my skills in clear communication and visual design. My experience with tools like SharePoint, Power BI, and Databricks, along with my ability to quickly learn new platforms, aligns well with the requirements of this internship. I am particularly drawn to the chance to develop micro-learning content and support employee engagement through events and knowledge sharing.

I am eager to bring my creativity and technical aptitude to your team and help strengthen data literacy across the organization. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Data Literacy Communications Internship at TotalEnergies Belgium. With a background in digital marketing, web design, and content creation, I am eager to contribute to your mission of strengthening data literacy and fostering a data-driven culture.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have developed strong skills in creating clear, engaging content and managing websites. I regularly use tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and WordPress, and I am comfortable with data visualization and reporting. My experience with structured data and technical SEO has given me a solid understanding of data concepts, including quality, governance, and visualization. I am also proficient in using SharePoint, Power BI, and Databricks, and I am keen to deepen my knowledge of Collibra and ChatGPT Enterprise.

What draws me to this internship is the opportunity to combine my communication skills with my interest in data. I enjoy breaking down complex topics into accessible content, whether through written guides, visual materials, or short videos. I am confident in my ability to craft engaging "How-to" and "Did you know?" pieces that resonate with employees and promote confident, compliant data use.

I am particularly inspired by TotalEnergies' commitment to innovation and sustainability. The chance to support the 2026 data literacy plan, including events and micro-learning, aligns perfectly with my career goals. I am a quick learner, adaptable, and eager to contribute to a team that values diversity and individual development.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm can benefit your team.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok

Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support.
